android.desc:
⋆˚꩜｡Turn your voice into text—and transcribed text back into voice—with Klarity AI:
Klarity AI is your all-in-one voice recorder, transcription, and document assistant. Capture thoughts, meetings, or lectures and instantly turn them into text. Scan documents, summarize, organize, and keep all your notes at your fingertips.


✨ Key Features
🟢 Voice to Text
Record meetings, conversations, and quick ideas, then get instant, accurate transcription.

🟢 Smart Search
Find what you need inside your notes in seconds.

🟢 Download Audio
Save your recordings directly to your device Gallery for offline access.

🟢 Summaries
Turn long recordings into clear, concise summaries that are easy to review.

🟢 Audio Playback
Listen to recordings with smooth playback controls.

🟢 Organize and Tag
Keep every note neatly arranged with custom tags for fast retrieval.

🟢 Scan Documents
Scan pages, extract text, and transcribe existing audio files.

🟢 Google Drive Backup
Keep your data safe with optional cloud backup using your Google account.


🎯 Perfect For
❇ Students who want organized lecture notes
❇ Professionals reviewing meeting or project notes
❇ Language learners capturing and practicing text
❇ Creators capturing and refining ideas on the go
❇ Anyone who wants to quickly convert speech or documents into text
🚀 Why Klarity AI?
Unlike ordinary recorders, Klarity AI does more than just capture sound. It transforms your voice into accurate, summarized text—and plays it back naturally. Your ideas aren’t just recorded; they’re made clearer, smarter, and more useful.

Stop typing. Start speaking.

With Klarity AI, your voice becomes text, your text becomes speech, and your notes are always at your fingertips.
